title: Save Our World
description: Begin your journey to save a broken world.
body:
The world is broken. The Ender Dragon is to blame. Only you can save us!

## Overview
This modpack includes _The Broken Script_, _no_moon.jar_ and several horror mods. It's combined with _End Remastered_, which gives players a reason to explore the world. No camping, only moving forward.

## Before Playing
- Modpack is preconfigured, it will not **crash** your game or **ban** you.
- Modpack includes [Keep Some Inventory](https://modrinth.com/datapack/keep-some-inventory), which lets player keep most **equipment** and **The Eyes** when they die.
- Press **C** to zoom.
